input_evidence: SELECT 'bronze' AS layer, input_kind, receipt_evidence, slice_class, COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'silver', input_kind, receipt_evidence, slice_class, COUNT(*) FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY layer, input_kind, receipt_evidence
slot_outcomes: SELECT slot, disposition, transaction_status, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(fee_lamports) AS fee_lamports_total FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY slot, disposition, transaction_status
sells: SELECT slot, transaction_index, mint, amount_raw_u64, token_amount_raw_u64, sol_amount_raw_u64, min_sol_output_raw_u64, transaction_status, outer_index, instruction_inner_order, instruction_stack_height, event_inner_order, event_stack_height, subtree_start, subtree_end_exclusive, event_association, cpi_flags_evidence, cpi_signer, cpi_writable, quote_mint_identity, quote_decimals, base_decimals, timestamp_raw_i64, raw_sha256, bronze_record_sha256, record_sha256 FROM silver WHERE is_buy IS FALSE ORDER BY record_ordinal
rejected_buy: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT slot,transaction_index,disposition,transaction_status,raw_sha256,record_sha256,record_ordinal,json_extract(decode(record_bytes),'$.transaction.pump_structural_analysis.buy_source_diagnostics') AS diagnoses FROM bronze) SELECT b.slot, b.transaction_index, b.disposition AS bronze_outcome, b.transaction_status, json_extract_string(d.value, '$.admission') AS instruction_admission, json_extract_string(d.value, '$.full_instruction_error.reason') AS reason, json_extract_string(d.value, '$.unexplained_suffix.hex') AS retained_suffix, json_extract_string(d.value, '$.unexplained_suffix.semantics') AS suffix_semantics, b.raw_sha256, b.record_sha256 FROM projected b, json_each(b.diagnoses) d ORDER BY b.record_ordinal, CAST(d.key AS BIGINT)
metadata_states: SELECT 'bronze' AS layer, name_state, ticker_state, launch_at_state, COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'silver', name_state, ticker_state, launch_at_state, COUNT(*) FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY layer, name_state, ticker_state, launch_at_state
bronze_unknown_economics: SELECT economic_identity, economic_identity_state, COUNT(*) AS records FROM bronze GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
unknown_economics: SELECT quote_mint_identity, quote_decimals_state, base_decimals_state, executable_price_state, net_proceeds_state, historical_activation, root_to_slot_membership, COUNT(*) AS records FROM silver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
coverage: SELECT slot, COUNT(*) AS envelopes, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE transaction_status = 'ERROR') AS failed_retained, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pump_program_involvement) AS pump_program_references, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_metadata_bytes IS NULL) AS metadata_bytes_absent FROM bronze GROUP BY slot ORDER BY slot
parent_binding: SELECT COUNT(*) AS silver_records, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bronze b WHERE s.bronze_record_sha256=b.record_sha256 AND s.slot=b.slot AND s.transaction_index=b.transaction_index AND s.raw_sha256=b.raw_sha256)) AS matching_bronze_parents FROM silver s
buys: SELECT slot,transaction_index,record_schema,mint,spendable_quote_in_raw_u64,min_tokens_out_raw_u64,token_amount_raw_u64,sol_amount_raw_u64,quote_amount_raw_u64,event_instruction_name,track_volume,transaction_status,outer_index,instruction_inner_order,event_inner_order,event_stack_height,event_association,cpi_signer,cpi_writable,json_extract_string(decode(record_bytes),'$.quote_account_address') AS quote_account_address,quote_mint_identity,quote_mint_raw_hex,quote_decimals,base_decimals,creator_address_reported,account_contents_verified,committed_account_state,raw_sha256,bronze_record_sha256,record_sha256 FROM silver WHERE is_buy IS TRUE ORDER BY record_ordinal
